fields.name: Database provider
fields.definition: One of ArgentSea's database-platform packages: ArgentSea.Sql (SQL Server, over SqlClient) or ArgentSea.Pg (PostgreSQL, over Npgsql). Each supplies the platform's configuration options and global, database and shard-set sections, its mapping attributes, typed parameter extension methods, data provider services and service registration, all on top of the shared provider-neutral core (ArgentSea). A model's attributes belong to exactly one provider.
